item.title: Fort Bragg Celebrates Sam Chelanga’s Half Marathon Victory
item.description: More than a thousand runners filled the Main Post Parade Field and streets early Saturday morning for the annual All American Races Half Marathon and 5K, an event that brings Soldiers, families, and community members together for fitness, pride, and friendly competition. This year’s spotlight shined brightest on 41-year-old Army Capt. Sam Chelanga, who crossed the finish line first in the Half Marathon with a commanding lead time and an impressive average pace of 4 minutes, 57 seconds a mile.

item.title: Calvin Pilgrim Celebrates Retirement after 45 Years of Service to the Nation
item.description: Calvin Pilgrim concluded his distinguished career at Project Manager Terrestrial Sensors (PM TS) at Fort Belvoir, as the director of operations, after 45 years of service to the nation.

item.title: USACE Honors Its Recipients on Medal of Honor Day
item.description: Each year on March 25, the nation observes National Medal of Honor Day, dedicated to recognizing the extraordinary courage of service members who distinguished themselves at the risk of their own lives, “above and beyond the call of duty,” during combat operations. As the United States approaches its 250th birthday, the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) reflects not only on the nation’s history, but also on the engineer leaders whose efforts helped shape it.

item.title: Madigan Head and Neck Cancer Screening Event Scheduled for April 29, 2026 - GRAPHIC

item.title: Operation Celebration: Army &amp; Air Force Exchange Service to Salute Military Kids
item.description: Throughout the month of April, the Army &amp; Air Force Exchange Service is celebrating with free events, giveaways, activities and sweepstakes for military children.

item.title: U.S. Strengthens Maritime Security Cooperation with Kenya During NAVAF Commander’s Visit
item.description: U.S. Naval Forces Africa (NAVAF) strengthened its longstanding security partnership with Kenya during Adm. George Wikoff’s visit to Nairobi and Mombasa, March 24–25.

item.title: Culinary Easter traditions in Tuscany
item.description: Easter in Tuscany is not just a religious celebration; it is a time when families and communities come together to honor traditions, many of which revolve around food. The region’s culinary Easter customs reflect its rich history, deep-rooted culture, and love for seasonal, local ingredients. From sweet breads to savory dishes, the Easter table in Tuscany is a feast for the senses.

item.title: NAVSUP FLC Yokosuka Holds Change of Command Ceremony
item.description: YOKOSUKA, Japan (March 31, 2026) -- Capt. Tom Arnold relieved Capt. Frank Kim of command to become the 41st commanding officer of Naval Supply Fleet Logistics Center, Yokosuka (NAVSUP FLCY), on Mar. 24 during a change of command ceremony held onboard Commander, Fleet Activities Yokosuka.

item.title: Marine Rotational Force – Southeast Asia continues Alliance with Philippines
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The 15th Marine Expeditionary Unit concluded its rotation with Marine Rotational Force – Southeast Asia on March 31, after enhancing combined readiness with the Armed Forces of the Philippines and regional partners in Indonesia, Malaysia, Brunei, and Thailand. item.title: Ventilation Upgrades Improve Soldier Safety at Trzebień Installation Site
item.description: TRZEBIEŃ, Poland — Soldiers at the U.S. Army Garrison Poland installation site in Trzebień, located within the Świętoszów Military Community, now have a safer and more effective workspace following upgrades to ventilation systems in maintenance tents, resolving a long-standing safety concern and improving operational conditions for rotational forces.

item.title: Cherry Point Clinic Farewells Three Sailors
item.description: Staff serving at Naval Health Clinic Cherry Point bid Fair Winds and Following Seas to three Corpsmen on Tuesday, March 31 as they departed for their next assignment in the U.S. Navy.

item.title: NAVFAC EURAFCENT delivers new CQB complex to Kenyan Navy Marine Commandos
item.description: Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Europe, Africa, Central (EURAFCENT) Expeditionary Directorate transferred a new Close Quarters Battle Complex to the Kenyan Navy (KNAV) Marine Commandos during a ribbon cutting ceremony March 25 at the Kenyan Navy base in Mtongwe County.

item.title: Senior U.S. Army Medical leader in Europe Highlights Allied Medical Readiness at Medical Symposium in London
item.description: U.S. Army Brig. Gen. Roger Giraud, commander of Medical Readiness Command, Europe, and command surgeon for U.S. Army Europe and Africa emphasized the importance of collective medical readiness during the 2026 Deployed Medical & Healthcare Delivery (DMHD) symposium in London on March 24-25.

item.title: Navy’s Free Barracks Wi-Fi Program Reaches Installations in Italy and Greece
item.description: WASHINGTON D.C. (April 1, 2026) – The Navy’s initiative to provide free, high-speed Wi-Fi to all Navy-owned and -operated unaccompanied housing (UH) has reached 86 percent completion, with the service now available in 827 of 952 total buildings since launching last November.

item.title: Eighty Years Serving the Fleet: Supporting readiness, rhythm, and Navy life wherever duty calls
item.description: For 80 years, the Navy Exchange Service Command (NEXCOM), has supported readiness in ways that feel familiar, dependable and steady. Founded in the aftermath of World War II, NEXCOM’s origins were shaped by a simple but essential challenge: how to reliably support the Navy on land and at sea.
